welcomeIntro: Copy on one device, paste on another. Your clipboard is encrypted before it leaves this computer.
welcomeFirstDetail: Start here if clipsync isn't on any of your devices yet
welcomeJoinDetail: Enter a code from a device that runs clipsync

@welcomeRelay.description: A link on the welcome page, when the user chose a relay of their own.

joinIntro: On a device that already runs clipsync, choose Add device. Then enter the code it shows here, or paste its pairing link.
joinInvalid: Enter the code from your other device, such as 42 183 059, or paste its pairing link.
joinWrongCode: That code didn't work. Check it, or get a new code on your other device.
joinCodeGone: That code has expired or was already used. Get a new code on your other device.
joinOffline: Can't reach {host}. Check your connection and try again.
joined: Paired. Copy something to try it.
readyIntro: Now add your phone or another computer. You can also do it later from Devices.
pasteboardNote: When another device sends text for the first time, macOS may ask whether clipsync can paste. Click Allow, so it can keep your clipboards in sync.
phoneStep1: Scan this QR code with your Android phone's camera
phoneStep2: Download the clipsync app if you don't have it yet
phoneNote: Only Android phones are supported for now.
phoneCode: No camera? In the app, tap Enter a code and type this one:

@phoneCode.description: Enter a code is the button in the Android app, as there.

qrLabel: QR code of the pairing link
computerStep1: Download clipsync on the other computer
computerStep2: Open it and choose Join my other devices
orLink: Can't use a code? Paste this pairing link instead.
codeFailed: Can't make a code. Check your connection.

@codeOnce.description: About the pairing code: it pairs one device, and expires after 10 minutes.

codeJoined: A device joined. This new code is for the next one.
codeWrong: Someone entered a wrong code, so it stopped working.
secretWarning: Anyone with this code or link can join your devices. Share them only with your own devices.

@deviceSeen.description: ago is a relative time, as "5 minutes ago" or "yesterday".

noOtherDevices: Your other devices show up here once they connect. Update them if they don't.
removeText: This computer moves to a new pairing that {name} can't join. Then add your other devices again: on each one, unpair it and enter the code that this computer shows. Until then, they keep syncing with {name}.
removeTextRelay: If your relay lets in only one pairing, first put the new Relay token from Settings on it, then click New code.
removed: Removed {name}. Now add your other devices again.
devicePending: Add it again with a code
addMoreDetail: Pair a phone or a computer
statusSyncingDetail: Connected to {host}. Copy something to send it to your devices.

@statusLastSync.description: ago is a relative time, as "2 minutes ago" or "now".

statusRefusedDetail: {host} refused this pairing. Check that the relay knows its token, in Settings.
statusBrokenDetail: clipsync can't use this computer's clipboard. Show the logs in Settings to learn why.
statusPausedDetail: Nothing is sent or received until you resume.
openAtLoginDetail: Keeps your clipboards in sync from the moment you log in
showInMenuBarDetail: When it's off, open clipsync again to see this window
showInTrayDetail: When it's off, open clipsync again to see this window
autoUpdateDetail: Installs new versions in the background
relayPublic: The public relay. It only ever sees encrypted text.
relayTokenDetail: Add it to your relay's CLIPSYNC_TOKEN, so that it lets your devices in
unpairDetail: Stops syncing on this computer. Your other devices stay paired.
unpairText: Sync stops here. To pair again, enter a code from another device.
relayIntro: The relay passes encrypted text between your devices. Use your own to keep even that on your server.
relayInvalid: Enter an address such as https://clip.example.com
relayRepair: Your other devices keep using the old relay. Pair them again afterwards.
